messages:
deploy-bot: [auto] SBOM_PROVENANCE_ANOMALY for release=2.9.0 component=auth-core detected by sbom-scan v3.5

maria.k: FYI staging queue paused. sbom scan finds auth-core@3.1.0 with no build provenance entry (we have 3.0.7 recorded). canaries not advancing.

alex: short diff pls

maria.k: ```
- auth-core@3.0.7 (sha256:aa11bb) -> expected, signed
+ auth-core@3.1.0 (sha256:cc22dd) -> upstream changed, no signature in provenance index
```
no buildid for 3.1.0. transitive bump: crypto-lite 1.8.0 -> 1.9.0

security: crypto-lite@1.9.0 shows CVE-2025-1234 high (libx use-after-free). upstream claims exploit not applicable for our usage, but we need to validate.

sam: options: 1) pin auth-core to 3.0.7 (patch release), 2) hotpatch (replace transitive dep), 3) accept staging-only canary exception and run exploit matrix. prod must be gated until sign-off.

jen: change window opens in 45m for a 90m slot. if we don't resolve by then prod rollout will be pushed 24h.

alex: pin would be a delta release (2.9.0-p1) and ~20-40m dev work + QA. rollback of the upstream bump would touch unrelated config; slower. hotpatch might be faster if small.

security: proposal: allow explicit, timeboxed canary in staging only (record exception), spin up targeted fuzz and exploit tests against crypto-lite 1.9.0, create a remediation ticket to pin or revert. if tests fail -> immediate rollback and quarantine.

sam: I'll run the exploit fixtures and targeted fuzz now, report in 30.

alex: I'll open the pin PR (branch: release/2.9-pin-auth-core-3.0.7) and prepare rollback runbook + checklist.

maria.k: @deploy-bot please record release exception: scope=staging reason="sbom provenance missing; staging canary allowed, timeboxed" owner=alex

deploy-bot: [auto] Exception recorded (id=ex-8844). Canary allowed in staging only. Production remains blocked until security sign-off.

jen: noted. tagging release lead @alex — if security clears before window close we go to prod, otherwise block.

security: tests started — running targeted exploit suite + runtime sanitizers. will update with verdict. :mag:

sam: initial fuzz pass looks clean so far (10m). proceeding with memcheck.

alex: PR opened and linked in release notes. I've included rollback steps and estimated times.

security: memcheck shows a dubious alloc path, running deeper triage. if we see regression we require rollback. ETA 25m.

maria.k: thanks. if security green before window close, we proceed with hotpatch/pin and prod rollout. if not, we'll defer prod and unblock staging for further testing only.

alex: copying release notes snippet into the record: "2.9.0 - temporary staging exception for auth-core provenance anomaly; pin to 3.0.7 staged as mitigation; prod blocked pending security verification."

sam: will post final test report in 20.

security: final: no exploitable path found in our runtime after extended tests. approval: security sign-off for canary -> staged hotpatch -> prod contingent on patch merge and CI green. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [auto] Prod hold lifted conditionally (release=2.9.0) after security sign-off. Please follow rollout playbook.

maria.k: proceeding with merge + canary -> prod per playbook. closing thread once prod complete. :thumbsup:
